bias.zh: 反弹 · 突破 $203，SAR 转为看多

read.en: Zscaler rose 4.0% on Nov 19 to $205.71, trading $201.46–218.07 on heavy volume (1.57x the 20-day average). It is above the 5-day ($194.4) and 10-day ($195.1), both falling, the rising 100-day ($187.2) and the 200-day ($166.6), but below the falling 30-day ($219.3). MACD has been below its signal since Nov 2, below zero, histogram narrowing toward a cross; Parabolic SAR flipped bullish on Nov 19 ($180.47), and RSI is 48.1.
read.zh: Zscaler 11月19日上涨 4.0%，收于 $205.71，盘中区间 $201.46–218.07，成交量放大（为 20 日均量的 1.57 倍）。股价位于均在下行的 5 日（$194.4）和 10 日均线（$195.1）、上行的 100 日均线（$187.2）以及 200 日均线（$166.6）上方，但低于下行的 30 日均线（$219.3）。MACD 自 11月2日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄、接近交叉；抛物线 SAR 于 11月19日转为看多（$180.47），RSI 为 48.1。

read.en: The close cleared the $202.4–203.3 resistance (Nov 11 high, Oct 16 low), now support, but the $218.07 high faded at the $217–219.3 band (Nov 5 high, 30-day). Resistance is $210.5 (Nov 6 high), then $217–219.3 and $224.4–229.9 (Nov 4 close and high). Support is $201.5–203.3, then $194.4–197.8 (5-day, 10-day, Nov 18 close) and $186.5–187.2 (100-day). A close above $219.3 would target $224–230; below $201.5, $194–198.

s.en: Nov 19 low $201.46; Nov 11 high $203.00; Oct 16 low $203.33, reclaimed
